brief:
British police said Friday they were assessing a social media post in which the wife of National Security Adviser Jonathan Powell appeared to express support for Palestine Action, Middle East Eye reported. The post drew attention after the group claimed responsibility for disrupting operations at a weapons manufacturing facility.

Powell, who advises Prime Minister Keir Starmer on national security matters, has not commented on his wife's social media activity. Palestine Action has staged repeated protests at arms manufacturers supplying Israel, blocking entrances and disrupting operations at multiple sites.
